name: n4_refrigeration_faults
description: Refrigeration fault rules over history data, report only (read-only). Each rule named in rules reads its histories over the window (period, or start/end as n4_read_history takes them; one GET per history, read once per call, ISO timestamps and locale-free values) and lists its findings as {count, items, more} (up to limit items, each with fact). Every threshold is an argument, with no default: sources disagree (a short cycle is a run under about 2 minutes for some and under 10 for others). short_cycling: runs of the compressor run history shorter than min_run_s (a run still on at the window end is not judged) and clock hours with more than max_starts_per_hour starts. defrost_termination: every defrost cycle classified by the highest coil temperature during it: ended by temperature (reached terminate_temp), by time (did not, and lasted at least max_minutes - slack_minutes; this is the finding), early, or open; cycles counts each. setpoint_not_reached: periods the room temperature stayed above setpoint + band for at least min_minutes (a sample holds until the next), skipping the periods exclude_history (for example the defrost) is true. over_amps: the clock hours with samples above limit, with the count and the peak. door_drift: door openings after which the room temperature rose more than max_rise above its value at the opening, looking until the door closed plus after_minutes. A boolean history counts true as on. A rule whose history could not be read is {not_checked: why}, never clean; summary has one line per rule (ok, N finding(s), not checked: why); histories lists each read with records and truncated (more records existed: the oldest were cut; narrow the window or raise max_rows).

rules.description: The rules to run, each with its histories and thresholds

run_history.description: Compressor run (boolean) history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

max_starts_per_hour.description: Most starts allowed in one clock hour

defrost_history.description: Defrost active (boolean) history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

coil_history.description: Evaporator coil temperature history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

terminate_temp.description: Coil temperature that ends a defrost

slack_minutes.description: A cycle within this of max_minutes counts as ended by time

temp_history.description: Room temperature history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

exclude_history.description: Optional boolean whose true periods are skipped (e.g. defrost); history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

amps_history.description: Compressor current history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

door_history.description: Door open (boolean) history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

temp_history.description: Room temperature history id (/<station>/<name>, or a bare name of the connected station)

max_rise.description: Largest acceptable rise after an opening

after_minutes.description: Minutes after the door closed still counted

period.description: A history period instead of start/end, as n4_read_history takes it (e.g. today, yesterday, last7Days)

end.description: Window end, BAbsTime; an event still open at the end is cut there
